subject: Post-demo: Embedded assistant trial — acceptance criteria, SDK routes, streaming plan
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@cypheredge.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: samir@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-25T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up from today's demo — embedded assistant trial

Thanks for the walkthrough today, Priyom. Samir and I talked through the product and we like the embedded assistant approach (in-app, on-demand contextual answers). A couple follow-up asks so we can scope the trial (we're aiming for a 4-week PoC inside our mobile app):

- Success criteria: what does Redwood recommend for measurable acceptance? We need something our PMs can sign off on.
- SDK and streaming: we have an existing websocket channel in our app; curious about recommended routes and whether we should use Redwood streaming or your SDK built-in client.
- Tool calling: we will need to call our internal retrieval API and a small payments validator (server side). How does function/tool-calling work in a streaming session?

Can you send a concise plan with owners and timelines? If possible, include any caveats about rate limits or auth that our infra/security team should watch for.

—Elena
Product Lead, CypherEdge

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <elena@cypheredge.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, samir@cypheredge.com
Date: 2026-08-25T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's demo — embedded assistant trial

Elena — thanks for the note and great conversation today. Summary + proposed PoC plan below (short form). Ben and Marissa are looped for technical pairing and onboarding.

POC objective (4 weeks): Validate end-to-end embedded assistant in your mobile app that returns high-quality contextual answers while meeting latency and cost targets.

Success criteria (suggested):
- Quality: >= 88% pass rate on a 50-sample rubric (clarity + relevance + factual accuracy) judged by your PMs
- Latency: p50 < 250ms, p95 < 800ms for 32-token answers in normal network conditions
- Stability: <1% error rate (5xx or dropped streaming connection) during scripted traffic (100 concurrent sessions)
- Cost: token cost per 1k responses within the budget envelope we'll confirm (target < $X — TBD with finance)

Technical approach:
- SDK vs direct streaming: we recommend using Redwood's lightweight Web SDK for mobile (handles reconnection, SSE fallbacks, token refresh). Option B is direct websocket to /v1/stream if you want to reuse your existing channel — both supported.
- Recommended routes: POST /v1/generate for non-streaming, WS connect to /v1/stream for streaming responses, POST /v1/toolcall to register/execute server-side tools (signed webhook).
- Tool calling + streaming: tool calls are emitted as structured events mid-stream. Client receives a tool_request event, pauses finalization; server-side tool execution returns tool_response event and the model continues generation. We can run tool calls through your backend only (recommended) for secrets.
- Auth: short-lived JWTs (mobile) + server-side refresh for tool keys/calls. We will provide an example token refresh endpoint.

Owners & timeline (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): finalize mutual action plan and success criteria (Owner: Elena + Priyom)
- Week 1: SDK integration + basic generation tests (Owner: Ben)
- Week 2: Streaming + tool-call integration with retrieval + payments validator (Owner: Marissa)
- Week 3: Eval run (50 prompts), latency runs, and stability test (Owner: CypherEdge + Redwood SRE)
- Week 4: Acceptance review and handoff (Owners: Elena, Priyom, Ben)

Attachments: mutual action plan + checklist and a simple streaming diagram.

Next steps:
1) Can you confirm the proposed success criteria and budget guardrail?
2) If confirmed, we'll open a trial tenant and schedule two technical pairing sessions (Ben + Marissa) — suggested times later this week.

I'll follow up with the PoC checklist doc and a minimal SDK sample.

Thanks — talk soon.

Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Elena Morales <elena@cypheredge.com>
Cc: samir@cypheredge.com
Date: 2026-08-26T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Embedded assistant trial — acceptance criteria, SDK routes, streaming plan

Elena — quick technical addendum from my side after reviewing your app notes:

- Tokenization: recommend payload-level token cap of 1024 for context + 256 for response. We'll provide a client-side helper to compute token counts to avoid unexpected truncation.
- Batching: for multi-turn support, enable per-session prefix caching (KV cache) — reduces token cost on repeated system prompts.
- Streaming details: our /v1/stream supports WebSocket and Server-Sent Events (SSE). If your mobile app prefers lower overhead, WS is slightly better for bi-directional control events; SSE is simpler for uni-directional streaming.
- Fallbacks: we can configure automatic fallback to a quantized variant (lower cost) if latency SLO is missed. That will be part of the trial routing policy.

I'll prep a small repo with: mobile SDK snippet (auth refresh), a node example for server-side tool call handling, and a Postman collection for the routes. Sharing by EOD.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena@cypheredge.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, samir@cypheredge.com
Date: 2026-08-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Embedded assistant trial — acceptance criteria, SDK routes, streaming plan

Thanks Priyom/Ben — this is great. We're aligned on the acceptance criteria aside from the exact cost target (we'll confirm after a run-rate estimate). Confirming the PoC: 4 weeks, Redwood trial tenant, Ben for SDK pairing (Wed 8/28 11:00 PT) and Marissa for tool-calling session (Thu 8/29 10:00 PT).

We attached a short internal rubric for the 50-sample quality eval (clarity, relevance, hallucination flag). I'll upload the sample prompts before the eval week.

Two small questions before we kick off:
1) On auth: can Redwood issue mobile JWTs that expire in 15 minutes with a refresh token mechanism? We'll implement refresh on our backend.
2) On the payments validator: we prefer server-side tool calls only — can you confirm tool_call events won't leak to the client?

If yes on both, consider the plan approved from product. I'll ask procurement to start the trial paperwork.

—Elena
Product Lead, CypherEdge
